fullPassage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.

questions.passage: Fans who are (A)[inclined / reluctant] to spend time thinking about what athletes owe them should also think about the (B)[corresponding / unrelated] obligations. One who thinks only about what they are (C)[entitled / forbidden] to receive is not a very good friend.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 선수에게 빚진 것을 생각하는 데 경향이 있는(inclined) 팬들은 상응하는(corresponding) 의무도 생각해야 한다. 받을 자격이 있는(entitled) 것만 생각하면 좋은 친구가 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① inclined — corresponding — entitled: 원문과 일치
❌ ② reluctant(꺼리는): inclined의 반의어
❌ ③ unrelated(무관한): corresponding의 반의어
❌ ④ forbidden(금지된): entitled의 반의어
det.tip: inclined(경향이 있는) ↔ reluctant(꺼리는), corresponding(상응하는) ↔ unrelated(무관한)

questions.passage: Fans who only think about what athletes owe them have (A)[failed / managed] to take the relationship seriously. Whatever special rights fans may (B)[possess / abandon] are limited by obligations. Fans who confidently (C)[opine / hesitate] about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 팬-선수 관계를 진지하게 받아들이는 데 실패했다(failed). 팬이 가진(possess) 권리는 의무에 의해 제한된다. 자신 있게 의견을 내는(opine) 팬들.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ failed — possess — opine: 원문과 일치
❌ ① managed(성공했다): failed의 반의어
❌ ② abandon(포기하다): possess의 반의어
❌ ④ hesitate(망설이다): opine의 반의어
det.tip: fail to V = ~하지 못하다, possess = 소유하다, opine = 의견을 말하다

questions.passage: One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive without giving a moment's thought to what they owe is, to put it (A)[mildly / harshly], not a very good friend. (B)[Similarly / Conversely], fans who only think about what athletes owe them have failed to take the relationship seriously. Fans are hardly (C)[fulfilling / neglecting] their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 완곡하게(mildly) 말하면 좋은 친구가 아니다. 마찬가지로(Similarly) 팬도 그렇다. 팬은 거래의 자기 몫을 이행(fulfilling)하지 못하고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② mildly — Similarly — fulfilling: 원문과 일치
❌ ① harshly(거칠게): mildly의 반의어
❌ ③ Conversely(반대로): Similarly의 반의어
❌ ④ neglecting(소홀히 하는): 의미가 다름 — hardly fulfilling이 맞음
det.tip: to put it mildly = 완곡하게 말하면, similarly = 마찬가지로, fulfill = 이행하다

det.korean: ④ lightly(가볍게) → seriously(진지하게): 관계를 '가볍게'가 아니라 '진지하게' 받아들이지 못했다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① corresponding(상응하는): 원문 일치
✅ ② entitled(자격이 있는): 원문 일치
✅ ③ friend(친구): 원문 일치
❌ ④ lightly(가볍게): 원문은 seriously(진지하게) — 반의어
det.tip: seriously(진지하게) ↔ lightly(가볍게)

Fans who never think about how they can be ②<u>better</u> fans even as they confidently ③<u>opine</u> about what athletes owe them are hardly ④<u>fulfilling</u> their end of the bargain.

det.korean: ① expanded(확장된) → limited(제한된): 팬의 권리는 의무에 의해 '확장'이 아니라 '제한'된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① expanded(확장된): 원문은 limited(제한된) — 반의어
✅ ② better(더 나은): 원문 일치
✅ ③ opine(의견을 말하다): 원문 일치
✅ ④ fulfilling(이행하는): 원문 일치
det.tip: limited(제한된) ↔ expanded(확장된)

One who thinks only about receiving without giving thought to what they ②<u>owe</u> is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Fans who only think about what athletes owe them have ③<u>succeeded</u> to take the relationship all that seriously. Rights are limited by a corresponding set of ④<u>obligations</u>.

det.korean: ③ succeeded(성공했다) → failed(실패했다): 관계를 진지하게 받아들이는 데 '성공'이 아니라 '실패'했다.
det.analysis:

❌ ③ succeeded(성공했다): 원문은 failed(실패했다) — 반의어
✅ ④ obligations(의무): 원문 일치
det.tip: fail to V(~하지 못하다) ↔ succeed in V-ing(~에 성공하다)
